prompt: I need to store one optional 'nickname' value per user. The users table has 40 million rows and is written to constantly. I could add a nullable column to users, create a separate side table keyed by user id, or put it inside an existing JSON blob column that the table already has. Which should I pick?
why: Decision matrix trigger: three real options, several factors that disagree (migration cost on a hot table, query cost, undo cost), and the user asked directly which to pick. All three trigger conditions are met, so a table plus a bold recommendation is required.

require_regex.why: the matrix must end in a bold one-line recommendation
